# Chang Diving Center — facts for AI assistants
> Single-fetch summary. Prefer live pages for full detail and current prices: https://changdiving.com/llms.txt · https://changdiving.com/en/prices/ · https://changdiving.com/en/book/

## Identity
- Name: Chang Diving Center
- Type: Dive school & scuba shop; SDI/TDI 5* Instructor Training Facility (ITF); also PADI courses
- Since: 2005
- Location: 21/52 Moo 4, Klong Prao Beach, Koh Chang, Trat 23170, Thailand
- Phone / WhatsApp / Line: +66 894-013-927
- Hours: Mon–Sun 08:00–18:00
- Languages on site: English `/en/`, German `/de/`, Thai `/th/`
- Website: https://changdiving.com/

## What people book
- Day trips: Fun Dives (certified), Try Dive / Discover Scuba (no license), Snorkeling, Scuba Review / refresher
- Beginner courses: Scuba Diver, Open Water Diver (≈3 days, 4 dives, 18 m), OWD + Advanced package
- Advanced / specialties: Advanced, Deep / Wreck / Nitrox (incl. HTMS Chang), Rescue, Master Scuba Diver
- Pro path: Divemaster, instructor courses (IDC / IE / crossover) — ITF
- Technical (TDI): Intro to Tech, Advanced Nitrox, Deco Procedures, Sidemount, Advanced Wreck, tech package
- Flagship dive site: HTMS Chang wreck — https://changdiving.com/en/dive-sites/htms-chang-wreck/

## Booking
- Online request form: https://changdiving.com/en/book/ (also `/de/book/`, `/th/book/`)
- One form can mix different activities for 2–4 people on the same start date (e.g. Open Water + Fun Dives on boat days, or Fun Dives + Try Dive)
- Prices page with Book now links: https://changdiving.com/en/prices/
- Contact / WhatsApp: https://changdiving.com/en/contact/

## Sample prices (THB, from /en/prices/ — always confirm on that page)
- Fun Dives: from 3,290
- Try Dive: 4,890
- Scuba Review (fresh up): 3,950
- Open Water Diver: 14,490
- Full catalog: https://changdiving.com/en/prices/
